summary: Test suite provides solid coverage of core functionality (policies, deletion planning, summary, CLI parsing, workflow structure) with good error validation. However, significant gaps exist: empty artifact arrays untested, boundary conditions not verified (e.g., artifact exactly at age/size limits), edge cases like identical timestamps or N=0 in keepLatestN absent. Combined-policy interactions tested only once. Integration from CLI args through final output not end-to-end tested at unit level (harness/run-act-tests.ts covers act flow separately). Fixtures well-designed with makeArtifact() helper and fixed NOW constant, but some edge cases (all-deleted, no-delete scenarios, very large numbers) would slip through. Would catch basic regressions but miss boundary/edge case bugs.
